name: Ann Johnson
source:
Officer Ann Johnson grew up in a household full of boys. With 4 older brothers there is very little that surprises her about men. She held her own in the customary struggle to get in front of her siblings for every perk that was offered. In high school she roughed up a bully who was picking on one of her brothers. Ann will fuck you up if you mess with her family. She also may do it for the fun of it. Ann is spirited, courageous, and open-minded.

[Edited from in-game description]
